(Japanese: 謎の美少女ラグ Mysterious Beauty, Rug) is the 49th chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Rug, a mysterious girl, attempts to steal Ryouga's Burst Heart.
Karuta returns and has rapidly grown to a more adult body.
Karuta faces Rug in battle after she attempts to steal the Compass of Light.
